features.done: P1 logs this quarter's output metric, sees the trend against last year, and sees the gap to the peer benchmark they entered, all on their own device, in under two minutes. (on `index`, working offline)

features.done: P1 can add a new period entry (metric name, period label, value) and delete an entry they entered in error, without losing other entries. (on `index`, working offline)
features.title: Period entry and deletion

features.done: P1 sees a simple line or bar trend of their output metric over the periods they have logged, so they can say 'we are up 8% over three quarters' or 'we are flat' in one glance. (on `index`, working offline)
features.title: Trend view

features.done: P1 enters a peer benchmark value (sourced from a published report or a peer) and sees the gap as a number and a percentage, so they can say 'we are at 42, peers are at 50, the gap is 8 or 16%.' (on `index`, working offline)
features.title: Peer benchmark gap

features.done: P1 sees a clear empty state when no entries exist ('No output entries yet. Start with this quarter.') and a visible message if IndexedDB is unavailable or quota is exceeded, so no entry is lost silently. (on `index`, working offline)
features.title: Empty state and error handling
